content: Pita be Jon tauwai tarapiri babadidima4:0 Section heading footnote kwa kitana, Luk 22:63nopone. ḡarodie a verauḡedina
Pita be Jon yaḡoro banaga ḡarodie a giugiuna maika, pirisi, Sadisi be tempol taurabedima adi badama Pita be Jon ḡarodie a tavana.
Taudi nuedima yai medina, baninama Pita be Jon banaga awai katakataidi be a riuriuedina da Yesu gurie ya midisuḡu munaḡana aubainama, tokare banaga matabudi gurie be ta midisuḡu munaḡana.
Vutuna aubainama a panidi be ravi aubainama dibure a biridina naumeki da raḡan ya tom.
Be banaga toitoi Pita na giuma a vaivaiena ai sumaḡana. Be yodi tauwai sumaḡa tautauḡoma sievinama ya tausaḡana 5 tausand.
Naumeki da pomainama Jius adi babadama be babada dosidima be tarawatu tauwai katakataidima ai rawateḡeidi be ai boruna Jerusalem nopone.
Banaga uma borune, Anas tauna pirisi adi badama, Kaiyapas, Jon, Alexanda be tautauḡoma ḡesaudima pirisi adi badama na dame banegidima mate.
Taudi Pita be Jon poudie ai midiridi be ai taraviredina, “Aba rewapanine bo aba isane taumi uma kauinama koya voie?”
Dabudine Pita noponama Arua Babau ya moḡavu be ya riuedina, “Jius babadimima be babada dosimima koi beavaia.
Tauma manaka kowai taravireviremaina, voia verenama banaga tuera paḡopaḡonama ḡarone ya tubuḡana aubainama. Taumi kowai taravireviremaina da aiyabae uma baneginama ya yawasana.

Naumeki da ka riuemi be taumi be Israel banagimima matabumi ko vaie. Nasaret Yesu Kerisonama taumi koya tupatuparatuna, tauna Mamaitua gurie ya kawa midisuḡu munaḡena, tauna isane uma baneginama yodi ya yawasana be noḡomie e midimidina.

content.text: ‘Tauna yekunama vutuna taumi vada taukerinama koya tuaḡaiena, be yekunama Mamaitua ya voie da na vadama yasinama ya tubuḡana’.

content: “Nam aitau tenaḡa tokare ei yawasanimi, baninama dobu matabuna nopone nam ai isa ima kenakenana da isane yawasana tai baḡe, ibewa da Yesu taunaḡa isane.”

Raḡanine Pita be Jon adi raudebatorama a kitakitana, taudi a base kauedina, baninama taudi a kataiena da Pita be Jon taudi nam giruma kaua banegidi, be taudi banaga yababa. Taudi a kataiena da uma banegidima noḡone Yesu mate naḡonaḡodima.
Be yodi taudi ta kitana be banaga waiwai yawasaninama tauna diedie mate a midimidina. Vutuna aubainama taudi nam teneteneḡina da sibo ḡarodie aba a giue.
Naumeki be Sanedrion nopone be a riupore dobiḡedi be babada taudiḡa ai tarapiri vivirana.
Be taudiḡa ai taravira munaḡedina, “Uma banegidima nema tà bakedi? Jerusalem banegidima matabudi a kataiena da uma banegidima mataira dosinama a voiena, be tauda nam teneteneḡina da tà boviedi.
Be uma kauinama tà riutuaḡaie da nam banaga ḡarodie e daberara, vutuna aubainama uma banegidima nuedima tà boru da nam aitau ḡarone Yesu isane ta giu munaḡa.”
Dabudine Pita be Jon a riuedi da Sanedrion nopone a saḡa munaḡa be a riu vavasaḡedina da nam sibo Yesu isane a giu bo ai katakatai rubu.
Be taudi a paribeedi be a riuna, “Taumiḡa ko kaivira da Mamaitua matane deḡo tauna ya vere. Mamaitua riunama ka voie bo taumi riumima ka voie?
Tauma nam teneteneḡina da aba ke kitakitana be ke vaivaiena giuenama ka gose.”

Naumeki da a riuwai nainairidi be a gosedi da a naḡona, baninama taudi nam ti kataiena da nema sibo a kovoḡa bakedi. Be banaga matabudi inam matairinama dosinama aubainama, Mamaitua isanama a kaikai suḡusuḡuna,
baninama uma tauḡominama tuera paḡopaḡonama tauna nama ya tubuḡena naumeki da yodi na suarama 40 be ya saḡa porena.
Tauwai sumaḡa raudebatora aubainama a moimoiragina
Raḡanine Pita be Jon a riuriuporedina, taudi a munaḡana adi banagama tauwai sumaḡa ḡarodie be yaba matabuna pirisi adi babada be babada dosidima aba a giugiuedina, nama ai maḡataridina.
Raḡanine adi banagama nama a vaivaiena, taudi a rawateḡeidi be a moiragina Mamaitua ḡarone, “Bada dosimma, tam mara, dobu, egasi be nopodie yaba matabuna kuya voiedina.
Tauma tamamaima Deivid, tam taunoyama, tam Arua Babaue kuya voie da tauna umanama ya giuna,

content.text: ‘Eteni banegidima aba aubainama ta medimedi? Inam banegidima aba aubainama taudi am kasirama ta tomtom yababe? Inam kasirinama kavakavanama.
Dobu guyaguyaudima a midi be babada dosidima a rawateḡeidi da Bada be na vinevinema tawai ḡaviedina.’

content: “Riukaua, Herod, Pontis Paelat, eteni banegidima be Israel mate uma meagaine a rawateḡeidi be am taunoyama babauna Yesu kuya vinevinena ai ḡaviena.
Be taudi aba am rewapanae be am ḡoanama oganama kuya tarataraḡina da sibo ya tubuḡana, nama yodi a voiena.
Be Bada, yodi adi raukivigewagewama ḡaromaie kwa noḡoti be kwa voiemai da tauma am taunoyama riumma raudebatorae ka giue.
Nimamma kwai yoyo waiyawasana aubainama da mataira be voia dosidima kwai tubuḡidina am taunoyama babaunama Yesu isane.”
Raḡanine moiragi ya kovikovina taudi deḡo awai rawateḡeidina gabunama yai tauyoyona. Be taudi matabudi Arua Babau yai moḡavudi be taudi Mamaitua riunama ma raudebatoredi a giuena.
Tauwai sumaḡa adi purapurama a dariḡedina
Tauwai sumaḡa banegidima matabudi nuenuedima be adi noḡotama tenaḡa. Be nam aitau tenaḡa i riuna taunaḡa na purapura, ibewa da matabudi ai sagu vivirana.
Dabudine apasol ma rewapana vavasaḡidi Bada Yesu ya guri ya midisuḡuna awai matematena. Be Mamaitua sagu dosinama matabudi ḡarodie ya riupore yovoḡena.
Be dabudine nam aitau poudie aba i maruabiena, baninama kana raḡanie aitauḡa doḡa be vada ḡarodie, a raugimaredi be mane
apasol ḡarodie a sivudina. Be aitau aba ya marumaruabiena, nama mane a utedina.
Maika Jousep tauna Livai damnama nopone be Saiprasma ya tubuḡana be apasol tauna awai isaisana Banabas. Isa Banabas baninama inam ‘taurau duḡu’.
Tauna doḡa yawai badena ya gimare be manenama ya verauḡena apasol ḡarodie dariḡenama aubainama.
